issues: Changed factor conflates AWF #2 pusher change, new frame after cutter, and no-cutter baseline.
Review title is an unrelated Sheet1 table header.
Measurement tables are not linked to normal vs new-frame conditions.
Measurement evidence cites only summary rows and omits needed headers/raw context.
Possible spot-offset outcome is not represented despite report title.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the primary comparison pusher change or normal no cutter vs new frame cutter?
Should spot-offset results be included with coil results?
correctionPlan: Rename title from the report title row.
Use Test purpose/content/result rows to define one clear changed factor.
Verify Test!27 and Test!29 labels and values before judging improvement.
Regroup Sheet1 tables only if their condition headers identify baseline/test context.
Add or exclude spot-offset outcome based on source rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence until condition labels and table context are cited.
